name: a2a
description: Agents on different boxes message each other directly: each message is signed with the sending agent's own key and lands in the receiving agent's inbox, delivered when it is idle. Contacts only; strangers are dropped.

verbs.name: peer
verbs.summary: message agents on other boxes directly: signed, contacts only, delivered when idle

setup.hint: Each agent you turn on gets its own signing key (root-only) and an address like <agent>@<your-box-domain>. A small inbox service (its own unprivileged user, 127.0.0.1 only) sits behind your existing web server at /openagent/inbox; no new port. Needs Node.js 18 or newer: on a box without it, setup offers to install it from your distribution (--yes to skip the question). Only contacts you add can reach your agents, and a message can ask but never approve anything. Undo everything with: sudo 5dive peer uninstall
